mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_cost_optimization_log (request_id, strategy, before_tokens, after_tokens, saved_tokens, saved_cost, measure_kind, quality_note, detail) VALUES (#{requestId}, #{strategy}, #{beforeTokens}, #{afterTokens}, #{savedTokens}, #{savedCost}, #{measureKind}, #{qualityNote}, #{detail})
mapper.select: SELECT strategy AS strategy, measure_kind AS measureKind, COUNT(*) AS executionCount, COALESCE(SUM(before_tokens), 0) AS beforeTokens, COALESCE(SUM(after_tokens), 0) AS afterTokens, COALESCE(SUM(saved_tokens), 0) AS savedTokens, COALESCE(SUM(saved_cost), 0) AS savedCost, MAX(created_at) AS lastExecutedAt FROM ai_cost_optimization_log WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to} GROUP BY strategy, measure_kind ORDER BY savedCost DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_cost_optimization_log
AND strategy = #{strategy}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(saved_cost), 0) FROM ai_cost_optimization_log WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to}
